summary: Iteration 31 — FINAL REGRESSION (round 3) of the 6 frontend fixes from iteration_30. Result: 6/6 PASS. Sanity checks (demo login, radar, professional-mode toggle, /email-preferences) also PASS. No new crashes, no red screens, no new console errors. Known-minor DEF-6 REPLACE navigator warning still emits on control login (deferred per request). Deprecated packages / SafeAreaView issues: none introduced by these fixes. shadow*/pointerEvents web console warnings unchanged (known non-bugs).

regression_results.DEF-1_register_password_placeholder: PASS — placeholder attribute on data-testid=register-password reads exactly 'At least 8 characters'. 7-char password submit shows inline 'Password must be at least 8 characters.' with zero /api/auth/register network calls.
regression_results.DEF-2_register_client_side_email_validat: PASS — submitting 'notanemail' with valid name+password+age+18-confirm produced inline error 'Please enter a valid email address.' and 0 /api/auth/register requests captured (client-side blocked before network).
regression_results.DEF-3_control_login_testIDs_and_brand: PASS — control-login-email, control-login-password, control-login-submit, control-login-error all reachable. Brand mark on /control/login shows 'OR'. Wrong creds → control-login-error visible with 'Invalid credentials'. qa-admin@intro.control / QaControl!2026x → /control dashboard loads with KPI cards + System Status + charts (users 80, pros 13, verified 13).
regression_results.DEF-4_bottom_tabs_testIDs: PASS — all 5 testIDs present (tab-radar, tab-nearby, tab-pings, tab-encounters, tab-profile). Clicking each triggers correct screen (radar blips render on tab-radar; 50 ping-row-* on tab-pings; logout-btn visible on tab-profile after popup cleared). URL stays '/' by design (Expo Router tabs group).
regression_results.DEF-5_pings_days_ago_formatting: PASS — Pings tab shows 50 ping-row-* entries; time strings observed: 'min ago' (4), 'days ago' (46), 'hr ago' (0). Zero '≥48 hr ago' strings anywhere. Screenshot confirms '9 days ago' for older demo pings and '1 min ago' / '12 min ago' for fresh ones. No '213 hr ago' style strings.
regression_results.DEF-6_REPLACE_warning: NOT RE-TESTED (deferred by request as known-minor). For record: warning still emits on successful admin login — 'The action REPLACE with payload {name:index} was not handled by any navigator.' Non-blocking, dashboard still loads.

sanity_results.demo_login: PASS — Explore Demo → /  with radar blips + DEMO badge
sanity_results.radar_renders: PASS — radar-blip-*/radar-cluster-* > 0 after both initial load and tab-radar click
sanity_results.professional_mode_switch: PASS — mode-professional toggle visible on profile; toggling triggers pro polling for /professional/connect/requests + /professional/sessions (both 200 in prior iterations). Note: within this run the tab-pings text label re-render lagged behind the toggle within 2.5s window (still read 'Pings') but no error, no crash; not a regression of DEF-4.
sanity_results.email_preferences: PASS — /email-preferences renders with title 'Email Preferences' and full copy 'Choose which emails you'd like from Orrbbit…'
sanity_results.console_errors: Only the known DEF-6 REPLACE warning + expected 401 on the intentional wrong-credentials probe. No new errors.

action_items: NONE required for the 6 fixes verified in this round.

Still open (deferred): DEF-6 — fix the console warning 'REPLACE payload name:index was not handled by any navigator' on successful /control login (likely a stray router.replace with legacy segment). Non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/(auth)/register.tsx now correctly validates: name → email present → email regex (line 32) → password length ≥ 8 (line 33) → age ≥ 18 → 18-confirm — all client-side before await register(); no accidental short-circuit.

/app/frontend/app/control/login.tsx: testIDs plumbed cleanly (Input passes through to underlying TextInput via spread; Btn now forwards testID prop on Pressable — /app/frontend/src/control/ui.tsx line 54).
/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx: uses tabBarButtonTestID (correct Expo Router API in current SDK) for each Tabs.Screen — verified rendered attribute data-testid on the pressable in DOM.

/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/pings.tsx timeAgo() now caps hours at 48 and returns Math.round(mins/1440) + ' days ago' — matches observed behaviour ('9 days ago' rows) and eliminates '213 hr ago' style output.

success_rate.backend: not tested this round (regression is frontend-only per request)
success_rate.frontend: 100% — 6/6 targeted fixes verified + 4/4 sanity checks pass
